name: Succubus Contract
source:
This is the story of a lonely guy and a succubus with an agenda. During the kiss, unbeknown to him, he had signed a contract with her, and in the morning realized that he has turned into a girl. That's how his adventure begins. Will he take advantage of this situation? Will he get rid of the shackles of the contract? Where will the future take him, and will he want to break this contract with the succubus? It's up to you to find out. 

[Edited from [url=https://www.patreon.com/stick4luck]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
这是一个孤独男子与一位别有打算的魅魔之间的故事。接吻时，他在毫不知情的情况下与她签订了契约，第二天早晨才发现，自己竟然变成了女孩。冒险就此开始。他会利用眼下的状况吗？能否摆脱契约的束缚？未来将带他走向何处，而他又是否仍想解除与魅魔的契约？答案等你揭晓。

[编译自[url=https://www.patreon.com/stick4luck]Patreon[/url]]
